title: Mixed-species pairs at rest, separation 3 to 5: a charge-mass pair law (A, B, C) predicts positions to 0.007

claims.statement: Two particles at rest of different species (A-B, A-C or B-C), initial separation in [3, 5], both at least 2.0 from every wall, observed for at most T = 2: each pair exerts equal and opposite forces q_i q_j K(r)/r^2.5 along the line of centres, with q_A = 1, q_B = 0.5, q_C = -0.5, K(r) the P-0029 table held constant below r = 5. Each particle accelerates with its force divided by its mass, m_A = 1, m_B = 0.72, m_C = 0.42. Measured tracker positions are predicted to a judged RMSE of 0.007 of the chamber side. Not claimed: same-species pairs (A-A, B-B, C-C), separation outside [3, 5], T above 2, contact, three or more particles, initial velocities.
